Job Description:

Position Overview
We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Benefits Consultant to join our growing team. This position will support a variety of employee benefits consulting engagements while developing expertise in benefits compliance, data analysis, and client service.

A significant component of this role will be supporting the annual preparation of Affordable Care Act (ACA) Forms 1094 and 1095 for contracted Baker Tilly clients. The Benefits Consultant will work closely with clients and internal team members to gather and validate data, identify and resolve discrepancies, prepare required forms, and help ensure accurate and timely completion of annual ACA reporting requirements.

This position is well suited for an early-career professional who enjoys working with data, solving problems, managing detailed processes, and providing high-quality service to clients.

Responsibilities
Benefits Consulting
- Support leadership and project teams on a variety of employee benefits consulting engagements.
- Assist with the collection, organization, review, and analysis of client benefits and employee data.
- Perform research and analysis related to employee benefits programs, compliance requirements, and industry practices.
- Prepare spreadsheets, analyses, client deliverables, presentations, and other project materials.
- Assist with recurring and special client projects, maintaining project schedules and helping ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
- Communicate with clients and internal team members to obtain information, resolve questions, and support project completion.
- Develop knowledge of employee benefit programs and applicable federal and state compliance requirements.

Affordable Care Act Reporting
- Play a key role in the team's annual ACA reporting process, including preparation of Forms 1094-B/C and 1095-B/C for contracted Baker Tilly clients.
- Coordinate with clients to obtain employee, eligibility, enrollment, payroll, and other information necessary to complete ACA reporting.
- Review and validate client-provided data for completeness and consistency and identify potential discrepancies requiring additional investigation.
- Assist with data imports, reconciliation, coding, and preparation of ACA reporting files and forms.
- Work with clients and senior team members to research and resolve data and reporting issues.
- Perform quality-control reviews to support accurate and timely preparation of client filings.
- Track client deliverables, outstanding information, and filing deadlines throughout the annual reporting cycle.
- Assist with corrections and other follow-up activities associated with ACA reporting.
- Maintain organized documentation and appropriately handle confidential employee and benefits information.
- Stay informed of changes to ACA reporting requirements, deadlines, and related guidance.

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in business, human resources, economics, data analytics, or a related field preferred.
- One (1) plus years of relevant professional experience are encouraged to apply.
- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with an ability to identify inconsistencies in large or complex data sets.
- Strong organizational and time-management skills, including the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and an interest in developing advanced spreadsheet and data-analysis skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to learn new systems, regulations, and technical concepts quickly.
- Demonstrated commitment to accuracy, confidentiality, and high-quality client service.
- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications
- Previous internship or professional experience in employee benefits, human resources, payroll, accounting, tax, compliance, consulting, or a related field.
- Experience working with large data sets, including data reconciliation and validation.
- Familiarity with employee benefits or Affordable Care Act employer reporting requirements.
- Experience with Excel functions such as lookups, pivot tables, formulas, and data manipulation.

The pay rate range for this job position is $51,200 to $100,680. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Job Description:

We are currently searching for an experienced performance management consultant to join our growing Baker Tilly Digital practice. As a part of Baker Tilly, you will find that our global brand and entrepreneurial environment will give you the support you need to apply your industry and technical experience to build your career across a wide range of services to meet our clients’ important needs. In this role, you will deliver consulting services involving Budgeting, Forecasting, Financial Consolidation, and Business Intelligence solutions to Baker Tilly clients. The position will require everything from business requirements and solution design to technical development. Baker Tilly works with some of the leading organizations of the world to implement successful budgeting and forecasting solutions. During your tenure with Baker Tilly, you will gain deep experience in the business process, industry, and technical aspects of these solutions.

It’s an exciting time to join Baker Tilly!

Responsibilities:
- Utilize application expertise, business knowledge, and technical skills to successfully support design, build, test, and deploy corporate/enterprise performance management (CPM/EPM) solutions to Baker Tilly clients.
- Support client workshops to gather requirements and build client design documentation for OneStream applications and solutions. Assist in the design of a comprehensive infrastructure framework within the OneStream financial application for clients based on requirements documentation.
- Engage in OneStream solution quality and testing, including unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing.
- Build, test & deploy reports, cube views, dashboards, templates and forms to meet client requirements.
- Work with our clients to develop a roadmap that encompasses an overall solution vision and effectively communicate initiatives across the entire project team.
- Identify new areas within the client’s business and forecasting processes where planning software can be better utilized to drive business results and increase the accuracy and efficiency of their budgets and forecasts.

Successful candidates will have:
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a closely related field.
- Minimum of three (3) years of experience in FP&A or FP&A consulting, including advising commercial companies and senior leadership.
- Experience implementing OneStream for financial planning or close & consolidation software.
- Previous experience working with external clients, including solution development and implementation using a leading ERP or EPM/CPM solution is a plus.
- OneStream Certified Associate preferred.
- Strong understanding of .NET and SQL development preferred.
- Ability to lead and mentor others, provide exceptional client service, demonstrate commitment to continuous learning, display appropriate ethical knowledge and commitment, and exhibit a sense of urgency and commitment to quality and the timely completion of projects.
- Demonstrated leadership, analytical, organizational, interpersonal, project management, and communication skills.

Job Description:

Baker Tilly offers an outstanding career opportunity for a Senior Consultant to join our Strategy and Transformation team; an integral part of our rapidly expanding Digital Solutions practice. Join a dynamic, innovative team driving digital transformation and operational excellence across diverse industries. This role blends expertise in change management, project management, process analysis, and business analysis to deliver impactful solutions, facilitate organizational change, and ensure successful project outcomes.

As a valued member of our Strategy & Transformation team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping transformation  strategy, transformation programs and delivering impactful change initiatives for leading organizations. You’ll collaborate with top talent to solve complex enterprise challenges, leveraging deep functional, industry, and technical expertise. Our flexible engagement model empowers you to drive meaningful results, helping clients achieve lasting success in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment.

You will enjoy this role if you :
•    Are seeking your next challenge, thrive on variety, and want your skills and experience to be fully utilized across diverse projects and programs.
•    Want to be part of a fast-growing, innovative practice where your hard work, creativity, and leadership in program and project management help us build, improve, and advance our solutions.
•    Have a passion for leading change—enabling organizations to meet objectives on time and on budget by driving adoption, optimizing processes, and delivering successful transformation initiatives.
•    Enjoy working with a variety of clients to analyze business needs, design and implement effective processes, and facilitate seamless information sharing across all components of the organization.
•    Are a team player with strong communication skills, eager to collaborate with others to meet client needs, and comfortable managing cross-functional teams and complex programs.
•    Excel when you’re part of a talented, down-to-earth team that thrives on collaboration, values diverse perspectives, and truly enjoys working together to solve business challenges.
•    Feel valued when provided with the resources and support to continually sharpen your technical, analytical, and leadership skills—building your career for today and tomorrow.

What you will do :
•    Manage and develop change management strategies and plans aligned to core change management methodology
•    Integrate appropriate change management techniques into established plans
•    Execute change management plan(s) and associated activities including stakeholder analysis and management, organizational readiness assessments, change impact analysis, communications and training
•    Work as the overall advocate to various stakeholders relative to implications of the future state on strategy, people, process and technology
•    Deploy change management techniques (e.g. communication, training, focus groups and many more techniques) to assist in the transition to the future state
•    Work as the overall advocate to various stakeholders relative to implications of the future state on strategy, people, process and technology. Lead the identification of organizational change risks and, collaboratively with stakeholders, develop mitigation approaches
•    Gather and analyze detailed information about the process design and the impact on the roles and the organizations affected. Understand the significance of changes to provide recommendations regarding expected organization impacts, and how to prepare the organization
•    Manage the delivery of end-user training, communications and subsequent follow-up activities, including effectiveness assessment
•    Generate and maintain advocacy at the executive level of the respective organizations and stakeholder buy-in for the implementation project
•    Support the impacted businesses with information and detailed frameworks, where appropriate, to ensure that they can conduct the necessary activities to minimize organizational risks
•    Measure effectiveness of change management plans and make adjustments where necessary
•    Utilize your entrepreneurial skills to network and build strong relationships internally and externally with clients and the community
•    Invest in your professional development individually and through participation in firm wide learning and development programs
•    Support the growth and development of team members and clients through the Baker Tilly Care and Teach philosophy, helping associates meet their professional goals

Baker Tilly continues to invest in helping utility organizations make sound financial decisions, align resources with long-term priorities, and deliver sustainable value to customers and communities.

As part of Baker Tilly's Public and Non-Profit Consulting practice, the Managing Director, Municipal Utility Advisory Practice will lead and expand a nationally recognized municipal utility finance and advisory platform. The successful candidate will combine deep utility expertise, proven practice-building experience, strong executive relationships, and entrepreneurial leadership.
This individual will set market strategy, broaden and connect Baker Tilly's utility advisory capabilities, originate and lead complex engagements, develop scalable solutions, expand revenue, build talent, and cultivate executive-level client relationships nationwide. The role will work across utility finance, rates and cost of service, strategic planning, capital and infrastructure, organizational performance, workforce, governance, technology, and operational improvement to deliver integrated solutions for municipally operated water, wastewater, stormwater, electric and gas utilities.

Responsibilities
Lead National Practice Growth

- Establish Baker Tilly as a recognized market leader in utility finance, rates, financial planning, and strategic advisory services.

- Drive growth through new client acquisition, geographic expansion, strategic account development, and collaboration across existing client relationships.

- Define priority markets, client segments, service offerings, and investment needs for sustainable national scale.

- Monitor emerging financial, regulatory, operational, infrastructure, technology, and workforce trends affecting utilities.

Build Market-Leading Utility Solutions
- Expand and connect Baker Tilly's utility advisory offerings into a cohesive, scalable national platform.

- Develop repeatable methods, tools, models, and client solutions across utility types and geographies.

- Lead or oversee solutions addressing:

- Utility rate studies and rate design

- Cost-of-service and revenue requirement analysis

- Long-range financial planning and forecasting

- Capital funding and financial strategy

- Scenario analysis, affordability, and financial sustainability

- Strategic planning and implementation

- Performance management, benchmarking, and organizational alignment

- Regulatory and financial advisory services

- Collaborate with leaders across capital and infrastructure, organizational performance, workforce, governance, grants, technology, and operational improvement to create integrated client solutions.

Business Development & Market Leadership
- Develop and maintain executive-level relationships with utility general managers, chief financial officers, finance directors, utility directors, boards, regulators, and other industry leaders.

- Originate, shape, and lead complex utility advisory engagements.

- Lead strategic pursuits, proposals, presentations, and account development efforts.

- Represent Baker Tilly through industry conferences, professional associations, publications, research, and other thought leadership.

- Build referral networks and strategic partnerships that strengthen market reach and capabilities.

- Translate market insight and client needs into new offerings and sustained revenue growth.

Client Delivery & Technical Leadership
- Serve as an executive advisor to utility leadership teams and governing bodies on financial and strategic decisions.

- Provide technical direction and quality oversight for complex engagements involving rates, cost of service, financial models, capital needs, and long-term strategy.

- Communicate complex financial and operational issues in clear, decision-ready terms for executives, boards, and public audiences.

- Ensure recommendations are practical, analytically sound, and responsive to regulatory, customer, affordability, and implementation considerations.

- Balance direct engagement leadership with development of a broader delivery team and consistent national methods.

- Recruit, develop, and retain top utility advisory talent.

- Build and leverage a scalable national team capable of delivering consistent, high-quality services across markets and utility types.

- Mentor emerging leaders and create clear opportunities for technical and business-development growth.

- Connect professionals across disciplines and geographies to deploy the best team for each client need.

- Foster a collaborative, entrepreneurial, innovative, and client-focused culture.

Practice Leadership
- Establish practice goals, performance measures, investment priorities, and growth plans.

- Develop delivery standards, quality-control practices, pricing approaches, and resource models that support profitable scale.

- Identify opportunities to create repeatable, technology-enabled, and potentially recurring advisory offerings.

- Collaborate with marketing and firm leadership to strengthen market visibility and thought leadership.

- Support strategic priorities across Baker Tilly's Public and Non-Profit Consulting practice.

Required
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, engineering, public administration, business administration, public policy, or a related field.

- 10 - 15 years of experience serving utilities through consulting, advisory services, utility leadership, public finance, regulatory work, or a related field.

- Demonstrated success building and scaling a consulting practice, service line, or advisory business.

- Demonstrated success generating significant revenue growth, originating work, and developing new client relationships.

- Deep expertise in utility rates, cost-of-service analysis, financial modeling, and long-range financial planning.

- Advanced financial modeling (3-statement models, 13-week cash flow, scenario analysis)
- Management reporting design, automation, and performance insights

- Dashboarding and analytics solutions (e.g., Power BI)
- Cross-functional business partnering with sales, operations, and executive teams

- Collaborate across service lines (e.g., transaction advisory, tax, audit, consulting) to deliver integrated, cross-functional solutions.

- Originate or expand client relationships, particularly within private equity firms and their portfolio companies, to drive new revenue and deepen existing accounts

- Contribute to thought leadership, client presentations and market-facing content to enhance the firm’s brand in FP&A and finance transformation.
- Actively participate in go-to-market strategies targeting high-growth and PE-backed companies.

- Help lead, mentor, and develop high-performing team members while fostering a culture of accountability, growth, and collaboration.
- Play a key role in recruiting and building out the team, particularly as the practice scales its capabilities.
- Provide technical guidance across financial modeling, FP&A processes, and client delivery.
- Operate as a player-coach, balancing hands-on problem solving with team leadership and oversight.

- 10–15+ years of relevant experience, ideally with a mix of: - Big 4 or national accounting/consulting firm experience
- Corporate FP&A or finance leadership roles
- Direct experience working with private equity firms and/or PE-backed portfolio companies

- CPA, CMA, CFA, or similar credentials strongly preferred.

- Strong understanding of private equity environments, including value creation, reporting expectations, and liquidity/cash management.

- Experience in business development, including winning new opportunities and contributing to revenue growth.
- Advanced financial modeling and analytical capabilities; strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.

- Strong project management and organizational skills in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
- Familiarity with US GAAP and broader finance/accounting processes.
- Ability to travel

Job Description:

Position Overview

The Director of Client Strategy & Growth serves as a strategic partner to the Practice Leader, with a dedicated focus on expanding market opportunities, strengthening client relationships, developing new business opportunities, and identifying what clients will need next across the mortgage industry.
This individual will combine deep mortgage industry expertise, an established network of industry relationships, strong client relationship skills, and a strategic growth mindset to help expand Baker Tilly's Mortgage Risk Advisory Practice across Mortgage Quality Control, Compliance, Servicing Quality Control, and related advisory services.

The Director will work closely with the Practice Leader to enhance the practice's ability to pursue new opportunities, deepen existing client relationships, increase market visibility, and proactively identify solutions to emerging client needs.

This role is intentionally different from a traditional Business Development position. The individual will collaborate with Baker Tilly's Business Development professionals while bringing the mortgage industry knowledge, executive relationships, client insight, and subject matter credibility necessary to develop opportunities and advance strategic client conversations.
The role is also designed to complement and enhance the Practice Leader's responsibilities. Overall practice strategy, operations, financial performance, service delivery, quality, client accountability, and people leadership remain the responsibility of the Practice Leader.

Primary Responsibilities

Strategic Growth & Market Development
- Partner with the Practice Leader to identify, develop, and advance growth opportunities across the mortgage industry.
- Leverage established industry relationships to create introductions and new opportunities with mortgage lenders, servicers, investors, and other market participants.
- Identify prospective organizations and decision-makers that align with the practice's capabilities and strategic growth objectives.
- Develop relationships with executive-level decision-makers and influencers throughout the mortgage industry.
- Support the development of strategic pursuits from initial relationship development through solution discussions, proposals, and presentations.
- Bring mortgage subject matter expertise and industry credibility into prospective client conversations.
- Identify opportunities to expand the practice into new segments, relationships, and areas of the mortgage lifecycle.
- Partner with the Practice Leader on targeted market strategies based on industry developments, client needs, and emerging opportunities.
- Collaborate with Baker Tilly Business Development professionals to complement firmwide sales efforts with mortgage-specific relationships, market intelligence, and subject matter expertise.

Client Relationship Expansion & Client Success
- Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across existing clients.
- Enhance the Practice Leader's ability to maintain proactive executive engagement across a growing client portfolio.
- Develop a deep understanding of each client's business model, strategic priorities, challenges, and future objectives.
- Identify opportunities to expand existing relationships through additional Mortgage Risk Advisory services.
- Proactively identify additional ways Baker Tilly can provide value beyond the client's current scope of services.
- Support strategic client discussions and executive business reviews focused on future needs, industry developments, and opportunities.
- Gather client feedback and market intelligence that can help strengthen relationships and identify future opportunities.
- Help ensure clients continue to view Baker Tilly as a trusted advisor and strategic partner rather than solely a service provider.
- Support client retention through proactive relationship development, responsiveness, industry insight, and continued value creation.

Strategic Client Insights & Growth Opportunities
- Leverage client discussions, industry trends, engagement results, and market intelligence to identify opportunities for deeper client engagement and practice growth.
- Partner with the Practice Leader to identify emerging client needs and determine where additional services, solutions, or advisory support may create value.
- Recognize trends across the client base that may signal broader market opportunities or the need for new or expanded service offerings.
- Use knowledge of a client's business, strategic priorities, and challenges to proactively bring forward ideas and opportunities beyond the current engagement.
- Help develop executive-level conversations that shift relationships from individual services to broader strategic discussions around risk, compliance, quality, servicing, technology, and business priorities.
- Identify opportunities to connect clients with additional capabilities across the Mortgage Risk Advisory Practice and broader Baker Tilly organization.
- Gather market and client intelligence that helps the Practice Leader determine where the practice should focus future growth efforts.
- Identify recurring client challenges that could be developed into scalable service offerings, advisory solutions, or targeted market initiatives.
- Help turn successful client solutions and outcomes into relevant market stories, thought leadership, and conversations with prospective clients.
- Proactively identify "what's next" for key clients—what challenges they are likely to face, what support they may need, and where Baker Tilly can engage before a formal need or opportunity is identified.

Mortgage Industry & Market Strategy
- Maintain a comprehensive understanding of developments across the mortgage lifecycle and the challenges affecting lenders, servicers, investors, and other industry participants.
- Monitor regulatory, agency, economic, technology, and market developments that could create new client needs or business opportunities.
- Translate industry developments into potential client conversations and market opportunities.
- Identify emerging areas where the practice can develop or expand capabilities to address changing client needs.
- Maintain awareness of competitor capabilities, market positioning, and service offerings to help identify opportunities for differentiation.
- Bring forward ideas regarding AI, automation, analytics, technology, and other emerging capabilities when they can create client value, support strategic growth, or create new service opportunities.
- Help the Practice Leader continuously evaluate where the mortgage market is heading and how the practice can remain ahead of changing client needs.

Industry Presence & Strategic Relationship Development
- Maintain and expand a strong network of relationships throughout the mortgage industry.
- Represent the Mortgage Risk Advisory Practice at relevant conferences, associations, industry events, and client meetings.
- Build relationships with mortgage executives, technology providers, industry organizations, investors, and other strategic market participants.
- Identify opportunities for strategic introductions, partnerships, and industry collaboration.
- Support thought leadership, webinars, industry discussions, and other opportunities that increase visibility for the Mortgage Risk Advisory Practice.
- Identify opportunities for the Practice Leader and other Baker Tilly leaders to engage with key industry decision-makers.
- Use industry relationships and market knowledge to identify prospective clients and emerging opportunities before they become formal pursuits.

Critical Skill Set
The ideal candidate will possess a unique combination of deep mortgage industry expertise, established relationships, strategic growth capabilities, client relationship skills, executive presence, and market awareness.

Deep Mortgage Lifecycle Expertise
The individual must possess comprehensive knowledge of the end-to-end mortgage lifecycle, including:
- Mortgage origination and loan manufacturing
- Processing and underwriting
- Closing and post-closing
- Mortgage Quality Control
- Regulatory compliance
- Operational and credit risk
- Servicing
- Default servicing and loss mitigation
- Investor and agency requirements
- Vendor oversight
- Mortgage technology and operational workflows

The individual should understand how these areas intersect and be able to recognize client challenges and opportunities across the mortgage lifecycle rather than having expertise limited to a single function.

Established Mortgage Industry Relationships
Deep, current industry relationships are a critical requirement for this position.
The ideal candidate will have:
- An established network of executive-level relationships throughout the mortgage industry.
- Current relationships with mortgage lenders, servicers, investors, technology providers, industry organizations, and other key market participants.
- Relationships with senior decision-makers and influencers responsible for mortgage operations, quality control, compliance, risk, servicing, technology, and related functions.
- A strong professional reputation and demonstrated credibility within the mortgage industry.
- The ability to leverage trusted relationships to create introductions, open doors, initiate strategic conversations, and identify opportunities for Baker Tilly.
- Active involvement and continued visibility within the mortgage industry rather than relying solely on historical relationships.
- The ability to build new relationships while maintaining and expanding an existing industry network.

Strategic Growth & Opportunity Development
- Demonstrated ability to identify and develop business opportunities through relationships, industry knowledge, and consultative engagement.
- Ability to recognize opportunities before a formal RFP or buying process begins.
- Strong understanding of how to move an opportunity from an industry or client conversation into a meaningful strategic pursuit.
- Ability to identify opportunities within both existing and prospective client relationships.
- Consultative approach focused on understanding business challenges and developing solutions rather than transactional selling.
- Ability to connect client needs with capabilities across Mortgage Risk Advisory and the broader Baker Tilly organization.
- Strong market awareness and ability to recognize where industry changes may create future demand.

Client Success & Executive Relationship Management
- Demonstrated ability to develop trusted, long-term relationships with executive-level clients.
- Strong understanding of client success and proactive relationship management.
- Ability to understand a client's broader organization, priorities, challenges, and future direction.
- Ability to recognize opportunities beyond the current scope of an engagement.
- Strong listening and consultative problem-solving skills.
- Ability to navigate complex or sensitive client discussions while maintaining strong relationships.
- Strong executive presence and credibility with senior mortgage industry leaders.

Strategic & Commercial Acumen
- Ability to understand the business drivers of mortgage lenders and servicers and how market conditions affect their priorities.
- Strong understanding of how client challenges translate into advisory opportunities.
- Ability to evaluate the potential value and strategic fit of new opportunities.
- Ability to identify patterns across clients and the market that could lead to scalable service offerings.
- Strong understanding of competitive positioning and differentiation.
- Ability to balance client needs, market opportunities, and Baker Tilly capabilities when developing potential solutions.

Technology, AI & Emerging Market Awareness
While this is not an innovation or technology leadership position, the individual should maintain awareness of technologies changing the mortgage industry.
The ideal candidate should have:
- Working knowledge of AI, automation, analytics, and emerging mortgage technologies.
- Understanding of how technology is changing mortgage origination, servicing, compliance, quality control, and risk management.
- Ability to recognize practical opportunities where technology may address client challenges or create new advisory opportunities.
- Ability to engage internal Baker Tilly resources when specialized technology or AI expertise is needed.
- Curiosity and a forward-looking mindset regarding how the mortgage industry will continue to evolve.

Executive Communication & Influence
- Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills.
- Ability to lead strategic conversations with senior mortgage executives.
- Ability to translate complex mortgage issues into clear business discussions.
- Strong relationship-building and influencing capabilities.
- Ability to represent Baker Tilly professionally at conferences, client meetings, and industry events.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with Practice Leadership, Principals, Business Development professionals, delivery leaders, and other Baker Tilly service lines.
- Ability to influence and advance initiatives without direct operational authority.

Desired Experience & Qualifications
- 15+ years of progressive experience within the mortgage industry.
- Significant experience across multiple areas of the mortgage lifecycle rather than expertise limited to one function.
- Deep knowledge of Mortgage Quality Control, Compliance, Servicing Quality Control, Risk, and related mortgage functions.
- Established and current executive-level network within the mortgage industry.
- Demonstrated success developing and expanding strategic client relationships.
- Demonstrated ability to create business opportunities through industry relationships, market knowledge, and consultative engagement.
- Experience working with mortgage lenders, servicers, investors, mortgage technology providers, consulting organizations, or other organizations supporting the mortgage industry.
- Experience interacting with senior and executive leadership within mortgage organizations.
- Understanding of mortgage technology platforms, analytics, automation, and emerging AI capabilities.
- Demonstrated industry presence through mortgage associations, conferences, committees, advisory groups, speaking engagements, webinars, thought leadership, or other industry involvement.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

What Success Looks Like
The Director of Client Strategy & Growth will enhance the Practice Leader's ability to expand and strengthen the Mortgage Risk Advisory Practice by:
- Creating new relationships and developing qualified client opportunities.
- Leveraging existing industry relationships to expand Baker Tilly's reach within the mortgage market.
- Increasing opportunities within existing client relationships.
- Strengthening executive relationships and contributing to long-term client retention.
- Identifying changing client needs and helping determine where Baker Tilly can provide additional value.
- Bringing market intelligence and client insights to the Practice Leader that inform growth priorities.
- Identifying new or expanded service opportunities based on recurring client and industry needs.
- Increasing the practice's visibility and strategic relationships throughout the mortgage industry.
- Working effectively with Baker Tilly Business Development professionals to advance opportunities without duplicating their role.
- Serving as a trusted strategic partner to the Practice Leader and increasing the Practice Leader's capacity to execute growth and client strategies while the Practice Leader retains overall responsibility and accountability for the strategy, leadership, operations, financial performance, delivery, quality, clients, and people of the Mortgage Risk Advisory Practice.

Job Description:

Responsibilities:
- Lead global client service teams in the following areas:
- Capital markets and SPAC transactions
- SEC/SEBI Reporting and Compliance Financial Accounting and Reporting
- GAAP conversions
- Transaction accounting - acquisitions, carve-outs, restructuring
- Accounting change (revenue recognition and lease accounting)
- Accounting policy manuals and technical accounting memorandums
- Organizing and providing technical training People management
- Lead a team of Associates and Seniors on client engagements and provide high quality delivery • People and performance management
- Conduct trainings for team members on accounting and reporting concepts

Qualifications:
- Chartered Accountant (CA) CPA (US) or ACCA (UK)
- 3–5 years of post–qualification experience in auditing, accounting, or financial reporting, with at least 2 years of advisory experience preferably with a Big 4
- Expert knowledge of IFRS or US GAAP and Ind-AS
- Extensive experience in the following areas:
- Financial statement preparation and consolidation process
- Technical accounting advisory on complex topics (e.g. business combinations, consolidation, debt/equity etc.)
- GAAP conversions and adoption of new accounting standards
- Drafting accounting policies and writing technical memorandums
- Candidates can expect at least two-three rounds of technical interviews
